title: Exchange Online & Hybrid Mail Flow — Architecture, Connectors & Routing
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Exchange/M365 messaging operations).

Exchange admin center / M365 admin center / Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph and on-prem Exchange Server + AD authored at exact detail from Microsoft public docs; version-/plan-dependent behavior (Exchange Server CU, EOP vs Defender for Office 365 plan, EOA/auto-expanding archive availability, Commercial vs Government cloud) cited or flagged 'verify in your tenant/version', never invented. Third-party hygiene/archiving/gateway tools at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell (EXO PowerShell / Graph) — no hardcoded credentials or secrets in code. No client names.
hook: Design and troubleshoot Exchange/M365 hybrid mail flow with confidence
problem: In an Exchange/Microsoft 365 hybrid environment, mail flow breaks in ways that are hard to trace — wrong connectors, centralized-transport surprises, and routing loops. This solution maps the hybrid mail-flow architecture end to end: the connector types (inbound/outbound, on-prem↔EXO hybrid, partner) and when to use each, accepted domains and routing, transport rules, centralized mail transport decisions, and a layered mail-flow troubleshooting method (message trace, headers, queues) — so mail routes correctly and issues are diagnosed fast.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the hybrid mail-flow model: connector types and their purpose, accepted domains, routing topologies, centralized transport, and the troubleshooting method.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (EXO + hybrid Exchange/AD, admin roles, DNS/MX, EXO PowerShell, pilot mail flow).

Implementation Guide — design/validate the connectors, set accepted domains + routing, decide centralized transport, apply transport rules, and run the layered mail-flow diagnostic (message trace → headers → queues) — pilot-first, each connector/rule named.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Exchange Online PowerShell (EXO V3) / Microsoft Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (mail routes correctly inbound/outbound/internal, no loops, trace clean) plus Best Practices for resilient hybrid mail flow.
short: Map and troubleshoot Exchange/M365 hybrid mail flow — connector types + when to use each, accepted domains + routing, centralized transport, transport rules, and a layered message-trace/headers/queues diagnostic — so mail routes correctly and issues are found fast. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
